deliveryLimits: 24 distinct one-frame actor candidates. Source posture is not source idle certification; hidden anatomy, viewpoint, scale and source temporal sequence remain unmeasured. Same-pose copies are not independent references or animated frames.

findings: All49 registered candidates appear once across real pagination pages18/18/13, with each thumbnail decoded and painted; no blank loading cards remain after root portrait-cache eviction correction.
All24 delivered subjects remain distinct one-frame idle-preview candidates.43 exact subjects and44 source-owned PNGs are automatically inspected; older airborne/pointing regressions remain.

Four new matches through normal controls preserve original SH2 GreatKnife versus Spear, Walter versus Eddie, NumbLarge versus female Sniffer, Cynthia versus Richard. All weapons/extremities and registered anchors/bounds fit the live camera.
Actual fixed-phase scene labels/neutral terrain remain intact in Bakery, Lakeview and roof tests; no scene image, source footage or stage geometry has been added in this art batch.
Six blocked IDs have no asset, inspector or duel link; rejected subjects do not receive an allowed variant bitmap.

Raised-knife Doctor, horizontal larva, wheelchair and BlueTremer inspector crops show complete registered body/props; static original model postures are not source-game idle or locomotion certification.
limitations: Original-source scale, timing, opposite side and support depth are unmeasured. Texture, saturation, hair/hand details and faint low-alpha fringe remain to compare.
NumbLarge uses family model anatomy and textually documented Large existence: zero Large-specific source views or measured size.
Five image-tool refusals and one partial-body reference gap remain blocked. No refusal was retried, no hidden worm anatomy invented.
Some original model postures are raised-weapon or floating/foreshortened views; their assignment to idle preview remains an authored versus convention.
Mobile combat remains a small16:9 letterboxed arena with very small HUD and actor details; no physical-device usability certification.

All24 delivered images remain unverified static candidates. Source posture assigned to the versus idle preview does not establish the original-game idle state, attack, locomotion, timing or animation.

Source scale, perspective, support depth, opposite side, hidden surface detail and faint low-alpha fringe remain unmeasured. Textures/contrast and red saturation are strengthened, with source margins/details sometimes reconstructed.

NumbLarge has zero Large-specific visual references: family anatomy plus a guide distinguishing small/medium/large establish a qualitative candidate, not original dimensions or a certified unique model view.

Five image-tool refusals (Incubus, NursePipe, Valtiel, Jasper, Andrew) and one incomplete body reference (SplitWorm) stay blocked. No rejected request was retried and no alternate allowed image was lent to those exact IDs.
The four new duels use adapted versus cameras/scale and existing candidate rooms. Their PNG presence and menu flow do not certify original source staging or hidden body anatomy.
430px portrait combat retains a small16:9 letterboxed arena and very small HUD/actor details. No physical-device usability or played campaign is claimed.
